# DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS
Longitudinal ED–6M differential expression analyses were performed separately within each APNS domain and latent class using dream/limma-voom. For each APNS × class subset, raw counts were filtered for low expression (filterByExpr, min.count = 3), normalized by TMM, and modeled with a linear mixed model including Timepoint (ED vs 6M) as a fixed effect and a random intercept for participant (PID). Empirical Bayes moderation was applied, and results were exported for all genes with logFC, moderated statistics, adjusted P-values, and mean voom-normalized expression at ED and 6M.

## Examine TMM scaling 
If the TMM scaling factors differ meaningfully acorss trajectories in each APNS, that suggests that global normalization may not be the best option and rather we should do within-class normalization. When comparing the TMM scaling factors across trajectories/classes for each APNS, the only APNS that had a nominally significant ANOVA was Pain. To keep consistency across analyses, global normalization was used for all APNS. 

### Prepare data 
```{r}

tmm_dir <- "Differential Expression Analyses/TMM Scaling Factor Analysis"

# Storage for all scaling factors
all_tmm_factors <- list()

for (APNS in APNS_ordered) {
  
  cat("\nProcessing APNS:", APNS, "\n")
  
  # All samples in this APNS
  apns_metadata <- coldata[!is.na(coldata[[APNS]]), ]
  apns_metadata$Timepoint <- relevel(factor(apns_metadata$Timepoint), ref = "ED")
  apns_metadata$PID <- factor(apns_metadata$PID)
  
  # Subset count matrix
  apns_counts <- count_matrix_t[, apns_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Create DGEList and normalize jointly
  dge_joint <- DGEList(counts = round(apns_counts), genes = rownames(apns_counts))
  keep <- filterByExpr(dge_joint, group = apns_metadata$Timepoint, min.count = 3)
  dge_joint <- dge_joint[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge_joint <- calcNormFactors(dge_joint)
  
  # Extract TMM norm factors and attach class labels
  tmm_df <- data.frame(
    INVENTORY.CODE = colnames(dge_joint),
    TMM_factor     = dge_joint$samples$norm.factors,
    lib_size       = dge_joint$samples$lib.size,
    APNS           = APNS
  )
  
  # Merge in class and timepoint info
  tmm_df <- merge(tmm_df, 
                  apns_metadata[, c("INVENTORY.CODE", "PID", "Timepoint", APNS)],
                  by = "INVENTORY.CODE")
  
  colnames(tmm_df)[colnames(tmm_df) == APNS] <- "Class"
  
  all_tmm_factors[[APNS]] <- tmm_df
}

# Combine all APNS results
tmm_combined <- do.call(rbind, all_tmm_factors)
rownames(tmm_combined) <- NULL

write.csv(tmm_combined, 
          file.path(tmm_dir, "TMM_Scaling_Factors_All.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


# Summary statistics — mean and SD of TMM factors per APNS × class

tmm_summary <- tmm_combined %>%
  group_by(APNS, Class) %>%
  summarise(
    N_samples = n(),
    Mean_TMM = round(mean(TMM_factor), 4),
    SD_TMM = round(sd(TMM_factor), 4),
    Median_TMM = round(median(TMM_factor), 4),
    Min_TMM = round(min(TMM_factor), 4),
    Max_TMM  = round(max(TMM_factor), 4),
    Range_TMM = round(max(TMM_factor) - min(TMM_factor), 4),
    .groups = "drop")

write.csv(tmm_summary, file.path(tmm_dir, "TMM_Scaling_Factor_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Stats
Statistical test — do TMM factors differ significantly across classes within each APNS?
```{r}
tmm_combined <- read.csv("Differential Expression Analyses/TMM Scaling Factor Analysis/TMM_Scaling_Factors_All.csv")

anova_results <- list()

for (APNS in APNS_ordered) {
  
  apns_data <- tmm_combined %>% filter(APNS == !!APNS)
  
  # Need at least 2 classes and enough samples
  if (length(unique(apns_data$Class)) < 2) next
  
  # One-way ANOVA: do TMM factors differ by class?
  fit <- aov(TMM_factor ~ Class, data = apns_data)
  p_val <- summary(fit)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
  
  # Effect size: eta-squared
  ss_between <- summary(fit)[[1]][["Sum Sq"]][1]
  ss_total   <- sum(summary(fit)[[1]][["Sum Sq"]])
  eta_sq     <- round(ss_between / ss_total, 3)
  
  anova_results[[APNS]] <- data.frame(
    APNS        = APNS,
    F_statistic = round(summary(fit)[[1]][["F value"]][1], 3),
    p_value     = round(p_val, 4),
    eta_squared = eta_sq,
    Significant = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
  )
  
  cat("\nAPNS:", APNS, "| ANOVA p =", round(p_val, 4), 
      "| eta² =", eta_sq, "\n")
}

anova_df <- do.call(rbind, anova_results)
rownames(anova_df) <- NULL

write.csv(anova_df, file.path("Differential Expression Analyses/TMM Scaling Factor Analysis/TMM_ANOVA_Results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## GLOBAL DEA
```{r}
RNA_counts <- RNA_seq_counts %>% dplyr::select(-PID)

DEA_metadata <- metadata_RNA %>%
  filter(INVENTORY.CODE %in% ED_M6_inventory_codes) %>%
  dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID, Timepoint, all_of(APNS_ordered))

# Data prep 
DEA_data <- merge(DEA_metadata, RNA_counts, by = "INVENTORY.CODE")

rownames(DEA_data) <- DEA_data$INVENTORY.CODE
coldata <- DEA_data[, 1:14]
count_matrix <- DEA_data[, 15:ncol(DEA_data)]

count_matrix_t <- t(count_matrix)
colnames(count_matrix_t) <- rownames(count_matrix)

coldata$PID <- factor(coldata$PID)
coldata$Timepoint <- relevel(factor(coldata$Timepoint), ref = "ED")

dim(count_matrix)

dge_global <- DGEList(counts = round(count_matrix_t), genes = rownames(count_matrix_t))
keep <- filterByExpr(dge_global, group = coldata$Timepoint, min.count = 3)
dge_global <- dge_global[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_global <- calcNormFactors(dge_global)

cat("Genes retained after global filtering:", nrow(dge_global), "\n")
dim(dge_global) #12513, 490

genes_tested_DEA <- rownames(dge_global)
#write.csv(genes_tested_DEA, "Differential Expression Analyses/Summaries/Genes_Tested.csv")


output_dir <- "Differential Expression Analyses/Results Per APNS Final"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

all_results_global <- list()


APNS_ordered 
  
param <- MulticoreParam(workers = detectCores())
param <- SerialParam()

for (APNS in APNS_ordered) {
   
   cat("\n============================\n")
   cat("Processing APNS:", APNS, "\n")
   cat("============================\n")
   
   classes <- unique(coldata[[APNS]][!is.na(coldata[[APNS]])])
   
   for (class in classes) {
     
     class_metadata <- coldata[!is.na(coldata[[APNS]]) & coldata[[APNS]] == class, ]
     class_metadata$Timepoint <- relevel(factor(class_metadata$Timepoint), ref = "ED")
     class_metadata$PID <- factor(class_metadata$PID)
     
     cat("  Processing class:", class, "| n =", nrow(class_metadata), "\n")
     
     if (nrow(class_metadata) < 10) {
       cat("    Skipping — too few samples\n")
       next
     }
     
     # Subset the globally normalized DGEList — no recalculation ever
     dge <- dge_global[, class_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE]
     
     form <- ~ Timepoint + (1 | PID)
     
     v   <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, class_metadata, BPPARAM = param)
     fit <- dream(v, form, class_metadata, BPPARAM = param)
     fit <- eBayes(fit)
     
     res_class <- topTable(fit, coef = "TimepointM6", number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
     res_class$APNS  <- APNS
     res_class$Class <- class
     res_class$Gene  <- rownames(res_class)
     
     res_class$Abs_logFC <- abs(res_class$logFC)
     res_class$Direction <- ifelse(res_class$logFC > 0, "Higher at M6", "Higher at ED")
     
     ED_samples <- intersect(class_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE[class_metadata$Timepoint == "ED"],
                             colnames(v$E))
     M6_samples <- intersect(class_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE[class_metadata$Timepoint == "M6"],
                             colnames(v$E))
     
     ED_means_df <- data.frame(Gene = rownames(v$E),
                               ED_mean = rowMeans(v$E[, ED_samples, drop = FALSE], 
                                                  na.rm = TRUE))
     M6_means_df <- data.frame(Gene = rownames(v$E),
                               M6_mean = rowMeans(v$E[, M6_samples, drop = FALSE], 
                                                  na.rm = TRUE))
     
     res_class <- merge(res_class, ED_means_df, by = "Gene", all.x = TRUE)
     res_class <- merge(res_class, M6_means_df, by = "Gene", all.x = TRUE)
     
     significant_genes     <- res_class[res_class$adj.P.Val < 0.01, ]
     non_significant_genes <- res_class[res_class$adj.P.Val >= 0.01, ]
     
     significant_genes     <- significant_genes[order(-significant_genes$Abs_logFC), ]
     non_significant_genes <- non_significant_genes[order(non_significant_genes$adj.P.Val), ]
     
     res_class <- rbind(significant_genes, non_significant_genes)
     
     res_class <- res_class[, c("Gene", "logFC", "Abs_logFC", "t", "B", "z.std",
                                "P.Value", "adj.P.Val", "Direction",
                                "AveExpr", "ED_mean", "M6_mean",
                                "APNS", "Class")]
     
     num_cols <- sapply(res_class, is.numeric)
     res_class[num_cols] <- lapply(res_class[num_cols], signif, digits = 3)
     
     write.csv(res_class,
               file = paste0(output_dir, "/DEA_", APNS, "_XX_", class, ".csv"),
               row.names = FALSE)
     
     all_results_global[[paste(APNS, class, sep = "_")]] <- res_class
     
     cat("    Done.\n")
   }
}
```

### Load in Results 
Differential expression (DE) output files for all APNS domain × class contrasts were loaded from the results directory and merged into a unified results table. Each CSV file corresponds to a single ED–M6 longitudinal contrast, and the originating filename was retained to preserve traceability to the specific model run.

Each DE result includes log2-CPM summaries generated by limma–voom (AveExpr, ED_mean, M6_mean). These values were back-transformed to estimated counts-per-million (CPM) using CPM = 2^log2CPM to facilitate interpretation of effect magnitudes. A weighted gene-level statistic was computed as
Weighted_Score = Abs_logFC × (−log10(adj.P.Val))
to jointly capture effect size and statistical significance.

The final merged dataset contains, for every gene in every APNS domain × class model, the log2 fold-change, moderated statistics, multiple-testing adjusted p-values, log2-CPM means at ED and M6 (and their CPM back-transformations), and the assigned APNS domain and latent class.
```{r}
# directory of results 
#de_results_dir <- "Differential Expression Analyses/Results per APNS/"  
de_results_dir <- "Differential Expression Analyses/Results Per APNS Final/"  

# list all CSV files in the directory
de_files <- list.files(de_results_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# read and merge all files into a single dataframe
# add file name for traceability
all_DEA_results <- purrr::map_dfr(de_files, function(file) {
  df <- read_csv(file) %>%
    mutate(File = basename(file))}) %>%
  mutate(APNS = recode(as.character(APNS),
                               "Loss" = "Depression"))

dim(all_DEA_results) #387903, 15

all_DEA_results$Weighted_Score <- (all_DEA_results$Abs_logFC*(-log10(all_DEA_results$adj.P.Val)))

all_DEA_results <- all_DEA_results %>%
  dplyr::rename(Avg_Log2CPM = AveExpr,
                Avg_ED_Log2CPM = ED_mean,
                Avg_6M_Log2CPM = M6_mean) %>%
  # back transform the log2-CPM counts to just estimated CPM 
  mutate(
    Avg_CPM = 2^Avg_Log2CPM,
    Avg_ED_CPM = 2^Avg_ED_Log2CPM,
    Avg_M6_CPM = 2^Avg_6M_Log2CPM)


colnames(all_DEA_results)
# "Gene"           "logFC"          "Abs_logFC"      "t"              "B"             
# "z.std"          "P.Value"        "adj.P.Val"      "Direction"      "Avg_Log2CPM"   
# "Avg_ED_Log2CPM" "Avg_6M_Log2CPM" "APNS"           "Class"          "File"          
# "Avg_CPM"        "Avg_ED_CPM"     "Avg_M6_CPM"  


# Create the table of all_DEA_results genes and order APNS and Class
all_DEA_results_full <- all_DEA_results %>%
  mutate(
    APNS = factor(APNS, levels = APNS_ordered),

  arrange(APNS, Class)

### Export spreadsheet 
```{r}

all_DEA_results <- all_DEA_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), format_num))

DEA_wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center", valign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")

apns_levels  <- c("Pain","Avoidance","Reexperience","Hyperarousal","Anxious",
                  "Somatic","MentalFatigue","Loss","Nightmare","Sleep")

class_levels <- c("Low","Moderate Recovery","Moderate","High")
class_code <- c("Low"="L","Moderate Recovery"="MR","Moderate"="M","High"="H")

make_sheet_name <- function(apns, cls, existing) {
  nm <- substr(paste0(apns, " - ", class_code[[cls]]), 1, 31)

  if (nm %in% existing) {
    i <- 2
    repeat {
      nm2 <- substr(paste0(nm, "_", i), 1, 31)
      if (!(nm2 %in% existing)) return(nm2)
      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
  nm
}

existing_sheets <- character(0)

for (apns in apns_levels) {
  for (cls in class_levels) {

    df_sub <- all_DEA_results %>%
      filter(APNS == apns, Class == cls) %>%
      arrange(as.numeric(adj.P.Val), as.numeric(P.Value))
    
    df_sub <- all_DEA_results %>%
      filter(APNS == apns, Class == cls) %>%
      mutate(adjP_num = as.numeric(adj.P.Val),
             abslogfc_num = as.numeric(Abs_logFC),
             sig = adjP_num < 0.01) %>%
      arrange(desc(sig),                                  
              desc(if_else(sig, abslogfc_num, NA_real_)), 
              if_else(!sig, adjP_num, Inf)) %>%
      dplyr::select(-adjP_num, -abslogfc_num, -sig)

    sheet_name <- make_sheet_name(apns, cls, existing_sheets)
    existing_sheets <- c(existing_sheets, sheet_name)

    addWorksheet(DEA_wb, sheet_name)
    writeData(DEA_wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df_sub, withFilter = FALSE)

    addStyle(DEA_wb, sheet_name, header_style,
             rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE)

    addStyle(DEA_wb, sheet_name, body_style,
             rows = 2:(nrow(df_sub) + 1),
             cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE)

    setColWidths(DEA_wb, sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), widths = "auto")
  }
}

saveWorkbook(DEA_wb, "Differential Expression Analyses/Summaries/DEA_Results_All_APNS_Class.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE)

```

## Recovered DEG lists 
Differential expression results (all_DEA_results) were restricted to the recovered class for each APNS domain, defined using the domain-specific recovery mapping (Moderate Recovery for Pain and Avoidance; Low for all other APNS). Within this recovered subset, genes were considered differentially expressed if they met the threshold FDR < 0.01.

For each APNS domain, the number of significant DEGs was recorded.

A binary Gene × APNS matrix was constructed by marking each gene as significant (1) or not significant (0) per recovered APNS domain. Genes that were significant in all 10 APNS domains formed the shared recovered DEG set, representing transcripts consistently altered across all manifestations of recovery.

A comprehensive recovered DEG set was also generated by taking the union of all genes significant in at least one recovered APNS domain (FDR < 0.01). For both shared and comprehensive gene sets, gene-level summaries were computed across recovered domains by averaging effect sizes and statistics (Abs_logFC, logFC, t-statistic, z-statistic, nominal and adjusted p-values, ED and M6 mean log2-CPM values, and the Weighted_Score).
```{r}
# subset to recovered contrasts only
DEA_results_recovered <- all_DEA_results %>%
  filter(
    APNS %in% APNS_ordered,
    Class == recovered_groups[APNS])

# per-APNS DEG counts (FDR < 0.01) for recovered groups
recovered_deg_summary <- DEA_results_recovered %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.01) %>%
  dplyr::count(APNS, Class, name = "N_DEGs") %>%
  mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = APNS_ordered)) %>%
  arrange(APNS)


# shared DEG list: genes significant in ALL 10 recovered APNS
table(DEA_results_recovered$APNS)
DEG_recovered_binary_matrix <- DEA_results_recovered %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.01) %>%
  distinct(Gene, APNS) %>%
  mutate(Count = 1L) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = APNS,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(APNS_count = rowSums(across(-Gene)))

shared_DEGs_list <- DEG_recovered_binary_matrix %>%
  filter(APNS_count == 10) %>%
  pull(Gene)

length(shared_DEGs_list)  # 3574 DEGs shared across all 10 recovered APNS
#write.csv(shared_DEGs_list, "Differential Expression Analyses/Summaries/Shared DEGs Across APNS List.csv")

# comprehensive DEG list: union across all recovered APNS 
comprehensive_deg_list <- DEA_results_recovered %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.01) %>%
  distinct(Gene) %>%
  pull(Gene)

length(comprehensive_deg_list)  # 8545 DEGs in ≥1 recovered APNS domain


# gene-level summaries (recovered-only & all contrasts) 
DEA_results_recovered_shared_summary <- DEA_results_recovered %>%
  filter(Gene %in% shared_DEGs_list) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    across(c(Abs_logFC, logFC, t, z.std, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Avg_ED_Log2CPM, Avg_6M_Log2CPM, Weighted_Score),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "Avg_{.col}"),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Avg_Abs_logFC))

#write.csv(DEA_results_recovered_shared_summary, "Differential Expression Analyses/Summaries/Shared DEGs Across APNS Summary Stats.csv")

## DOWNSAMPLE DEA 
Prep RNA 
```{r}

RNA_counts <- RNA_seq_counts %>% dplyr::select(-PID)

DEA_metadata <- metadata_RNA %>%
  filter(INVENTORY.CODE %in% ED_M6_inventory_codes) %>%

### Final Analysis 
```{r}

clean_filename <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+","_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_|_$", "",x)
  x
}

iteration_output_dir <- "Differential Expression Analyses/Downsampled Paired Limma DEA/Iteration Results 8"

run_paired_limma_iteration <- function(APNS, class, iteration, job_id, n_downsample, master_seed) {
  
  # File names
  APNS_file <- clean_filename(APNS)
  class_file <- clean_filename(class)

  iteration_file <- file.path(
    iteration_output_dir,
    paste0("DEA_", APNS_file, "_XX_", class_file, "_Iteration_", sprintf("%02d", iteration),".csv"))

  manifest_file <- file.path(manifest_output_dir, 
                             paste0("Participants_", APNS_file, "_XX_", class_file, "_Iteration_", 
                                    sprintf("%02d", iteration), ".csv"))

  # Metadata for this APNS × class
  class_metadata <- coldata %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data[[APNS]]),
      as.character(.data[[APNS]]) == as.character(class),
      as.character(Timepoint) %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      PID = as.character(PID),
      Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint),
      INVENTORY.CODE = as.character(INVENTORY.CODE))

  # Identify complete ED-M6 pairs
  eligible_PIDs <- class_metadata %>%
    dplyr::group_by(PID) %>%
    dplyr::pull(PID)

  ## Randomly sample 20 participants
  iteration_seed <- master_seed + (job_id * 1000) + iteration

  set.seed(iteration_seed)
  sampled_PIDs <- sample(eligible_PIDs, size = n_downsample, replace = FALSE)

  ## Retain ED and M6 samples for selected participants
  sampled_metadata <- class_metadata %>%
    dplyr::filter(PID %in% sampled_PIDs)


  ## Subset globally filtered / normalized DGEList

  ## Important:
  ## We do NOT rerun filterByExpr().
  ## All iterations use the same gene universe.

  dge <- dge_global[ , sampled_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE]

  ## Align metadata exactly to expression columns
  sampled_metadata <- sampled_metadata[match(colnames(dge), sampled_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE),
                                       ,drop = FALSE]

  ## Factor formatting
  sampled_metadata$PID <- factor(sampled_metadata$PID)

  sampled_metadata$Timepoint <- relevel(factor(sampled_metadata$Timepoint), ref = "ED")

  ## Paired fixed-effect design
  ##
  ## PID controls for participant-specific baseline expression.
  ## TimepointM6 therefore estimates within-participant ED→M6
  ## expression change.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  design <- model.matrix(~ PID + Timepoint, data = sampled_metadata)

  ## voom
  v <- limma::voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)

  ## limma
  fit <- limma::lmFit(v, design)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit, robust = TRUE)

  ## Extract ED → M6 differential expression
  res <- limma::topTable(fit, coef = "TimepointM6",
                         number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene")

  ## Mean normalized expression at ED and M6
  ED_samples <- sampled_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE[sampled_metadata$Timepoint == "ED"]

  M6_samples <- sampled_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE[sampled_metadata$Timepoint == "M6"]

  expression_means <- tibble::tibble(
    Gene = rownames(v$E),
    ED_mean = rowMeans(v$E[, ED_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    M6_mean = rowMeans(v$E[, M6_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))

  ## Add analysis information
  res <- res %>%
    dplyr::left_join(expression_means, by = "Gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      APNS = APNS,
      Class = as.character(class),
      Iteration = iteration,
      Seed = iteration_seed,
      N_Participants = n_downsample,
      N_Samples = nrow(sampled_metadata),
      Abs_logFC = abs(logFC),
      Direction = dplyr::if_else(logFC > 0, "Higher at M6", "Higher at ED"),
      Significant_FDR_001 = adj.P.Val < 0.01,
      Significant_FDR_005 = adj.P.Val < 0.05,
      Significant_P_005 = P.Value < 0.05)

  ## Arrange columns
  res <- res %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, logFC, Abs_logFC, t, B, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction,
                  Significant_FDR_001, Significant_FDR_005, Significant_P_005,
                  AveExpr, ED_mean, M6_mean, APNS, Class, Iteration, Seed,
                  N_Participants, N_Samples)
  
  
  
  # Calculate DEG counts BEFORE cleaning objects
  n_DEG_005 <- sum(res$adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_DEG_001 <- sum(res$adj.P.Val < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_Higher_ED_005 <- sum(res$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & res$logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_Higher_M6_005 <- sum(res$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & res$logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Participant manifest
  participant_manifest <- sampled_metadata %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        APNS = APNS,
        Class = as.character(class),
        Iteration = iteration,
        Seed = iteration_seed,
        PID = as.character(PID),
        INVENTORY.CODE = as.character(INVENTORY.CODE),
        Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(PID, factor(Timepoint, levels = c("ED", "M6")))
  
  # Save outputs
  readr::write_csv(res, iteration_file)
  readr::write_csv(participant_manifest, manifest_file)
  
  # Clean memory
  rm(dge, v, fit, sampled_metadata)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
  
  # Return only a lightweight summary
    invisible(
      tibble::tibble(
        APNS = APNS,
        Class = as.character(class),
        Iteration = iteration,
        Seed = iteration_seed,
        N_Participants = n_downsample,
        N_DEGs_FDR_005 = n_DEG_005,
        N_DEGs_FDR_001 = n_DEG_001,
        N_Higher_ED_FDR_005 = n_Higher_ED_005,
        N_Higher_M6_FDR_005 = n_Higher_M6_005
      )
    )
  }


n_downsample <- 20
n_iterations <- 10
master_seed <- 0307

iteration_job_grid <- purrr::map_dfr(APNS_ordered,
  function(APNS) {

    classes <- unique(as.character(coldata[[APNS]][!is.na(coldata[[APNS]])]))

    tidyr::crossing(
      APNS = APNS,
      Class = classes,
      Iteration = seq_len(n_iterations))}) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Job_ID = dplyr::row_number())

iteration_job_grid
nrow(iteration_job_grid)

all_iteration_summaries <- vector("list", nrow(iteration_job_grid))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(iteration_job_grid))) {

  job <- iteration_job_grid[i, ]

  cat("Job ", i, " / ", nrow(iteration_job_grid), "\n", sep = "")

  all_iteration_summaries[[i]] <- run_paired_limma_iteration(
    APNS = job$APNS,
    class = job$Class,
    iteration = job$Iteration,
    job_id = job$Job_ID,
    n_downsample = n_downsample,
    master_seed = master_seed)
}

iteration_DEG_counts <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_iteration_summaries)


iteration_DEG_counts

### Heatmap 
```{r}
iteration_output_dir <- "Differential Expression Analyses/Downsampled Paired Limma DEA/Iteration Results Final"

# Get all iteration result files
iteration_files <- list.files(iteration_output_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

length(iteration_files) # 10

iteration_DEG_counts <- purrr::map_dfr(
  iteration_files,
  function(file) {

    x <- readr::read_csv(file)

    x %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        APNS = dplyr::first(APNS),
        Class = dplyr::first(Class),
        Iteration = dplyr::first(Iteration),
        Seed = dplyr::first(Seed),
        N_Participants = dplyr::first(N_Participants),
        N_DEGs_FDR_005 = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        N_DEGs_FDR_001 = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
        N_Higher_ED_FDR_005 = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        N_Higher_M6_FDR_005 = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
)


downsample_heatmap_data <- iteration_DEG_counts %>%
  group_by(APNS,Class) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Iterations = n(),
    Median_DEGs_FDR_005 = median(N_DEGs_FDR_005, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_DEGs_FDR_005 = mean(N_DEGs_FDR_005, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_DEGs_FDR_005 = min(N_DEGs_FDR_005, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_DEGs_FDR_005 = max(N_DEGs_FDR_005, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

heatmap_data <- downsample_heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = (APNS_ordered), labels = APNS_labels),
         Class = factor(Class, levels = class_order),
         log_median_DEGs = log10(Median_DEGs_FDR_005 + 1),
         Median_Label = if_else(Median_DEGs_FDR_005 %% 1 == 0,
                                scales::comma(as.integer(Median_DEGs_FDR_005)),
      scales::comma(Median_DEGs_FDR_005, accuracy = 1)))

deg_fill_scale <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  name = "Median DEGs\nFDR < 0.05",
  colours = c(
    "#F0F5F6",
    "#B3D5DC",
    "#5799B2",
    "#006A98"
  ),
  limits = c(0, 2600),
  breaks = c(0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500)
)



p_downsample_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Class, y = APNS, fill = Median_DEGs_FDR_005)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Median_Label), size = 3) +
  deg_fill_scale +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  labs(x = NULL,y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 11,color =  "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text( color = "black", size = 11, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1), 
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11))

p_downsample_heatmap

ggsave(p_downsample_heatmap, filename = "Figures/Ext Data Fig 2 - Supplementary_DEA_Heatmap.jpg", width = 4.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
